meta.name: backlink-check
meta.description: Backlink profile for any domain — referring domains, authority, anchors, new/lost links, and a side-by-side vs a competitor. Use when asked "check my backlinks", "backlink profile of X", "who links to them", or "link gap vs competitor".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查任意域名的外链构成,并与竞品逐项对比,看清谁在链接你、谁在链接对手
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做 SEO,想搞清自己和对手在外链上的差距
copy.tagline_en: See who links to any domain and compare your backlink profile against a competitor's
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do SEO and need to see how your backlinks stack up against rivals.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为指定域名拉取外链档案：引荐域名、权重分布、锚文本、新增与丢失链接；给出对手域名时还会算出链接差距和外联名单。需先接好 Ryze MCP 数据源。
howto.when: 当你提到 “check my backlinks”“backlink profile of X”，或要对比和对手的链接差距时触发；使用前需先接好 Ryze MCP 连接器。

say.text: 帮我看看 example.com 的外链档案，列出引荐域名和锚文本分布
say.note: 会输出档案摘要表与头部引荐域名

say.text: 对比 example.com 和 rival.com，给我链接差距的外联名单
say.note: 列出只链对手、未链你的强域名

say.text: 我的外链里有没有垃圾锚文本或权重异常？
say.note: 会标出可疑锚文本模式与低权重占比

howto.what_en: Claude pulls a backlink profile for a domain: referring domains, authority, anchors, new/lost links. Name a competitor and it computes the link gap and outreach list. Requires the Ryze MCP connector.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "check my backlinks", "backlink profile of X", or for a link gap vs a competitor; the Ryze MCP connector must be set up first.

say_en.text: Check example.com's backlinks: referring domains and anchors.
say_en.note: Outputs a profile summary table and top referring domains.

say_en.text: Compare example.com with rival.com and list the link-gap outreach targets.
say_en.note: Lists strong domains linking to them but not to you.

say_en.text: Any spammy anchors or low-authority links in my backlink profile?
say_en.note: Flags exact-match anchor spikes and low-authority share.
